evidence_required: The placement argument linking DP groups to rails.

marking.criterion: DP groups consist of GPUs with the same TP rank and pipeline stage, which have the same local GPU index
Same local index means the same rail, since NIC i serves GPU i on rail i
Rail leaf r connects NIC r of all 32 nodes, so the traffic stays on one leaf and never reaches a spine

title: Why DP all-reduces never cross a spine
